hero:
SUPERVISED LEARNING · MODULE MAP

Practice with an answer key. Predict the answer for new data.

During training, each example comes with its correct label. At prediction time, the model does not get that label.

questions.stem: Machine Learningలో Supervised Learning అంటే ఏమిటి? Input Dataతో పాటు Correct Labels ఉన్న Examples నుంచి Computer New Inputsకి Predictions ఎలా Learn చేస్తుంది?
options: Labels లేకుండా Samplesని Similarity బట్టి Group చేసే Unsupervised Method.
Labeled Examples నుంచి Learn చేసి New Inputsకి Predict చేస్తుంది.
Training Examples Copy చేసి Identical New Inputs మాత్రమే Recognize చేసే System.
Labeled Examples నుంచి Learn చేయకుండా Every Inputకి Manual Rules Apply చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Supervised Learning అంటే Answer Keyతో Practice. Model Examples, Correct Labels చూసి New Inputsకి Prediction చేయడం Learn చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. Training Datasetలో Features X, Known Target y ఉంటాయి. Model X→y Relation Learn చేసి Unseen Dataకి Prediction ఇస్తుంది. Example Email Text Featuresకి Spam Label. Correct Labels Quality Important.
questions.figure:
01 · Everyday concept

Labeled examples are the practice answer key

Features are the clues. Labels are the correct answers shown during training.

questions.stem: Supervised Learningలో Classification, Regression మధ్య Difference ఏమిటి? Spam Emails Identify, House Prices Predict, Handwritten Digits Recognize చేయడంలో ఎలా Use చేస్తాం?
options: Classification Prices Predict చేస్తుంది; Regression Spam Categoriesని Predict చేస్తుంది.
Both Methods Categories మాత్రమే Predict చేస్తాయి; Regression More Training Data Use చేస్తుంది.
Classification Missing Fields Find చేస్తుంది; Regression Target Labels Define చేస్తుంది.
Classification Categories, Regression Numeric House Prices Predict చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Classification ఒక Category Choose చేస్తుంది, Example Spam/Not Spam. Regression Numeric Value Predict చేస్తుంది, Example House Price.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. Classification Discrete Classes Predict చేస్తుంది: Spam, Handwritten Digit. Regression Continuous Number Estimate చేస్తుంది: House Price. Classificationకి Precision/Recall, Regressionకి MAE/RMSE వంటి Different Metrics Use చేస్తాం.
questions.figure:
02 · Task comparison

Categories and numbers are different prediction jobs

Classification: spam or digit. Regression: an estimated house price. All example numbers are illustrative.

questions.stem: Labeled Datasetలో Features, Targets తీసుకుని Initial Predictions, Error Measurement, Parameter Updates ద్వారా Supervised Model Step by Step ఎలా Improve అవుతుంది?
options: Predictionsని Correct Labelsతో Compare చేసి Errors Reduce చేసేలా Model Update చేస్తుంది.
Difficult Rowsని Trainingకు ముందు Remove చేసి Initial Guessesనే Final Answersగా Treat చేస్తుంది.
Features Testing సమయంలో మాత్రమే Use చేసి Labelsని Predictions తర్వాత Create చేస్తుంది.
Random Answers Choose చేసి Correctness Check చేయకుండా Confidence మాత్రమే Increase చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Model Guess చేసి Correct Labelతో Compare చేస్తుంది. Error తగ్గించడానికి Weights లేదా Rules Adjust చేస్తూ Improve అవుతుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. Features, Target Labelsతో Model Predictions Calculate చేస్తుంది. Loss Differences Measure చేస్తుంది; Gradient-Based Models Backpropagation/Optimizer లేదా Other Algorithms Updates చేస్తాయి. Held-Out Dataపై Improvement Check చేయాలి.
questions.figure:
03 · Learning mechanism

The model improves through repeated feedback

Prediction → compare with the label → calculate error → update the model → repeat.

questions.stem: Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests, SVMs, Neural Networks Inputs, Outputs మధ్య Relationships ఎలా Learn చేస్తాయి? Suitable Algorithm ఎలా Choose చేస్తాం?
options: Every Algorithm Exactly Same Equation Use చేస్తుంది; Familiar Model Always Best.
Neural Networks Every Datasetకి Best; Linear Models Backup మాత్రమే.
Task, Data, Interpretability, Validation బట్టి Model Choose చేస్తాం.
Training Speed మాత్రమే Model Choice Decide చేస్తుంది; Error Rates Matter కాదు.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Different Algorithms Different Patterns Learn చేస్తాయి. Task Type, Data, Interpretability, Validation Performance బట్టి Model Select చేయాలి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. Linear Regression Numeric Trends, Logistic Regression Class Boundaries Model చేస్తాయి. Trees Rules, Random Forest Ensemble, SVM Margin, Neural Networks Learned Nonlinear Features Use చేస్తాయి. Complexity, Scale, Interpretability, Validation Compare చేయాలి.
questions.figure:
04 · Algorithm mechanisms

The choice depends on what pattern must be learned

The sketches show distinct fitting mechanisms rather than a universal winner.

questions.stem: Python, Scikit-learnలో Data Preparation, Missing Values, Feature Encoding, Train/Validation/Test Split, Model Training, Hyperparameter Tuning, Evaluationతో Complete Supervised Pipeline ఎలా Build చేస్తాం?
options: Full Datasetపై Imputation Fit చేసి Test Scoresతో Hyperparameters Tune చేస్తాం.
First Split, Training Pipelineలో Preprocessing Fit, Validation Tune, Final Test చేయాలి.
Before Split Encoding చేసి Classification, Regression రెండింటికి Accuracy Only Use చేస్తాం.
Every Labelతో Tune చేసి Training Dataని Final Test Resultsగా Report చేస్తాం.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: First Data Split చేయండి; Trainingపై Preprocessing, Model Tune చేయండి. Test Setని Final Unbiased Performance Checkకి Reserve చేయండి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. Train/Validation/Test Split Before Fitting Preprocessing చేయాలి. Scikit-learn Pipelineలో Imputation, One-Hot Encoding, Estimator Keep చేయాలి. Cross-Validationతో Tune చేసి Final Held-Out Testను One Time Evaluate చేయండి. Data Leakage Avoid చేయాలి.
questions.figure:
05 · Practical implementation

A training pipeline must keep the test data untouched

The Python diagram is abbreviated; the optional detailed explanation contains runnable Scikit-learn code.

questions.stem: Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM), Loss Functions, Regularization, Bias–Variance Trade-off, Generalization వల్ల Training Dataలో Good Accuracy ఉన్న Model New Dataలో ఎందుకు Fail కావచ్చు?
options: Training Overfit అవచ్చు; Validation, Regularization Helpful అవుతాయి.
Low Training Loss Future Dataలో Guaranteed Accuracyని Always Ensure చేస్తుంది.
Every Training Label Memorize చేస్తే Bias, Variance Automatically Zero అవుతాయి.
Regularization Data Shift ఉన్నా All Future Predictions Correctగా Makes చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Model Training Examples Memorize చేస్తే New Examplesపై Fail కావచ్చు. Validation, Regularization Generalizationని Improve చేయడంలో Help చేస్తాయి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. ERM Training Loss Minimize చేస్తుంది; Future Risk Different కావచ్చు. High Bias Underfit, High Variance Overfit. Regularization Complexity Control చేస్తుంది; Validation New Data Performanceని Estimate చేస్తుంది; Shift ఉంటే Re-Evaluate చేయాలి.
questions.figure:
06 · Bias-variance and generalization

Training loss can fall even while unseen error rises

The curves are illustrative. Validate on separate data and use regularization to control excessive complexity.

questions.stem: Production Supervised Learningలో Data Leakage, Imbalanced Classes, Noisy Labels, Distribution Shift, Calibration, Model Drift, Performance Monitoring, Retraining Decisionsని ఎలా Handle చేస్తాం?
options: Only Accuracy Monitor చేసి Every Week Evidence లేకుండానే Retrain చేస్తాం.
Copied Minority Samplesని Train, Final Test రెండింటిలో Insert చేస్తాం.
Daily Test Labelsతో Recalibrate చేసి Same Testపై Models Replace చేస్తాం.
Data Drift, Confidence Check చేసి Quality Dropపై Retrain చేస్తాం.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Launch తర్వాత Data, Performance Change అవవచ్చు. Drift, Class Imbalance, Confidence Monitor చేసి Evidence ఆధారంగా Retrain చేయాలి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. Data Leakage Prevent చేసి Imbalanced Dataకి Class Weights లేదా Train-Only Resampling Use చేయండి. Per-Class Metrics, Calibration, Drift, Label Noise Check చేసి Model Quality Decline అయితే Retrain/Migrate Consider చేయండి.
questions.figure:
07 · Production ML

Monitoring catches changes after the model is deployed

Drift alerts prompt investigation. Retrain only after a new model is validated against representative data.
